item.title: Doctors’ Groups Demand Internal Inquiry Into Housemen Scam, Victim Compensation
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MMA and HDK want an internal inquiry into the HTA housemen scam to address structural weaknesses that allowed the crime to occur in the workplace, beyond a police probe. The doctors' groups demand compensation for the 190 victims who suffered RM47k losses. item.title: Dental Officers’ Contracts Ending Today Without Permanent Appointments — MDA
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Contracts for the 2021 contract dental officer cohort are set to end today (April 6), July 11, and Sept, without clear direction on permanent appointments or extensions. These dentists have contributed to service delivery in the public health care system.
